certification_boundary: This evidence proves live staggered provisioning, immutable cluster placement, collective Ready state, and platform validation for three concurrently retained 25-seat workshops. It does not certify the 75-participant functional wave, manual browser usability, public access, soak behavior, or bulk reclaim. The workshops are intentionally retained for the next participant and manual gates.
